actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The goblin makes two Hex Stick attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Hex Stick
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description: The goblin casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

reactions.name: Jinx
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature the goblin can see hits it with an attack roll. Response—Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 13, the triggering creature. Failure: The attack misses instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The goblin makes three attacks, using Scimitar or Shortbow in any combination.
actions.attacks_text: three attacks, using Scimitar or Shortbow in any combination

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Slashing damage. If the attack roll had Advantage, the target takes an extra 5 (2d4) Slashing damage.
actions.additional_ruling: If the attack roll had Advantage, the target takes an extra 5 (2d4) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 80/320 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage. If the attack roll had Advantage, the target takes an extra 5 (2d4) Piercing damage.
actions.additional_ruling: If the attack roll had Advantage, the target takes an extra 5 (2d4) Piercing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Royal Command
bonus_actions.description: The goblin barks an order at up to two allied goblins within 30 feet of it that can hear it. Each of them can take a Reaction to move up to half its Speed and make one weapon attack.

reactions.name: Redirect Attack
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature the goblin can see makes an attack roll against it. Response: The goblin chooses a Medium or Small ally within 5 feet of itself. The goblin and that ally swap places, and the ally becomes the target of the attack instead.

combatants.senses: darkvision 60 ft., keen smell, Passive Perception 13

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.description: Greypaw has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

traits.name: Relentless Tracker
traits.description: Greypaw has advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks made to track creatures. It can identify a creature by scent after smelling something it touched or wore.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) Piercing damage.

combatants.name: Manifestation of Durmor
combatants.senses: Darkvision 60 ft., Tremorsense 60 ft., Passive Perception 10

traits.name: Earth Glide
traits.description: The manifestation can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone, leaving a glowing seam of cooling rock behind it.

traits.name: Illumination
traits.description: The manifestation sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet.

traits.name: Molten Body
traits.description: A creature that touches the manifestation or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 4 (1d8) Fire damage.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.description: The manifestation deals double damage to objects and structures.

traits.name: Water Susceptibility
traits.description: The manifestation takes 3 (1d6) Cold damage for every 5 feet it moves in water or for every gallon of water splashed on it, and its AC drops by 2 until the end of its next turn as its crust cracks.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The manifestation makes two attacks, using Molten Slam or Lava Lob in any combination.
actions.attacks_text: two attacks, using Molten Slam or Lava Lob in any combination

actions.name: Molten Slam
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage.

actions.name: Lava Lob
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 60 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.
actions.additional_ruling: If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Eruption (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature in a 15-foot Emanation originating from the manifestation. Failure: 16 (3d10) Fire damage. Success: Half damage. The ground in the Emanation becomes Difficult Terrain until the end of the manifestation's next turn.
actions.target: each creature in a 15-foot Emanation originating from the manifestation
actions.extra_ruling: The ground in the Emanation becomes Difficult Terrain until the end of the manifestation's next turn.
